title: UX Designer
description: Comprehensive curriculum covering cognitive psychology, qualitative and quantitative user research, information architecture, usability testing, accessibility, and UX leadership.

phases.title: UX Foundations
phases.focus: Cognitive Psychology, Generative Research, Personas & Journey Mapping

phases.title: Architecture & Testing
phases.focus: Information Architecture, Task Flows, Moderated Usability Testing & UX Writing

phases.title: Advanced Research & Experimentation
phases.focus: Heuristics, Mixed Methods, A/B Testing, Omnichannel Service Design & Ethical UX

phases.title: Leadership & Strategy
phases.focus: UX Strategy, Stakeholder Management, and Senior Case Study Defense

nodes.title: UX Foundations & Cognitive Psychology
nodes.subtitle: Mental models, cognitive load, Hick's Law, Fitts's Law, Miller's Law, Gestalt principles
learning_objectives: Apply Gestalt principles of visual grouping to digital interface layouts
Evaluate cognitive load and decision latency using Hick's Law and Fitts's Law
feynman_prompts: Explain how Fitts's law influences button sizing and placement on mobile devices.
key_misconceptions: Designing interfaces that force users to remember information across screen steps

nodes.title: Qualitative User Research Methodologies
nodes.subtitle: Generative interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, diary studies, focus groups
learning_objectives: Plan and conduct semi-structured user interviews with open-ended discovery questions
Observe users in their natural environment via contextual inquiry
feynman_prompts: Why are open-ended questions like 'Walk me through how you...' better than yes/no questions?
key_misconceptions: Pitching features or defending product ideas during research interviews

nodes.title: User Personas & Empathy Mapping
nodes.subtitle: Proto-personas, behavioral archetypes, empathy mapping (Says, Thinks, Does, Feels)
learning_objectives: Distill interview findings into actionable behavioral archetypes instead of demographics
Build 4-quadrant empathy maps to align cross-functional product teams
feynman_prompts: Why are behavioral personas superior to demographic personas (e.g. 'Jane, 35, suburban')?
key_misconceptions: Treating personas as fictional creative writing exercises unconnected to real research data

nodes.title: Customer Journey & Service Blueprinting
nodes.subtitle: User touchpoints, emotional highs/lows, frontstage vs backstage actions, pain point discovery
learning_objectives: Map end-to-end customer journeys highlighting pain points and opportunity areas
Create service blueprints connecting user actions to backend internal processes
feynman_prompts: How does a service blueprint uncover root causes of poor customer experiences?
key_misconceptions: Limiting journey maps strictly to on-screen UI clicks while ignoring offline touchpoints

nodes.title: Information Architecture & Card Sorting
nodes.subtitle: Tree testing, open vs closed card sorting, taxonomy, hierarchical vs flat navigation
learning_objectives: Run open and closed card sorting sessions to validate mental model categorization
Validate site navigation structures through quantitative tree testing
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between an open card sort and a closed card sort?
key_misconceptions: Organizing product navigation based on internal company org chart rather than user tasks

nodes.title: Task Flows & Low-Fidelity Wireframes
nodes.subtitle: User task flows, decision diamonds, wireframes, rapid sketch iterations
learning_objectives: Diagram step-by-step user task flows identifying happy paths and error branches
Translate user flows into clear, low-fidelity wireframe screens
feynman_prompts: Why is mapping decision branches essential before drawing screen wireframes?
key_misconceptions: Assuming every user completes a workflow linearly without interruptions or errors

nodes.title: Moderated Usability Testing & Protocols
nodes.subtitle: Test protocol scripting, think-aloud facilitation, observer debriefs, bias minimization
learning_objectives: Write unbiased usability test scenarios focused on real user tasks
Facilitate usability tests without providing hints or leading user actions
feynman_prompts: How do you handle a participant who asks 'Did I do this right?' during a test?
key_misconceptions: Intervening immediately whenever a user encounters friction instead of letting them explore

nodes.title: Unmoderated & Quantitative Usability Testing
nodes.subtitle: Maze/UserTesting tools, task completion rate, Time-on-Task, Single Ease Question (SEQ)
learning_objectives: Configure remote unmoderated usability tests with clear success criteria
Calculate task completion rates and evaluate Single Ease Question (SEQ) benchmarks
feynman_prompts: When should you choose unmoderated testing over moderated qualitative testing?
key_misconceptions: Trusting unmoderated test metrics without reviewing video screen recordings for context

nodes.title: Accessibility (a11y) & Inclusive Design
nodes.subtitle: WCAG 2.1 guidelines, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, color blindness simulation
learning_objectives: Audit interfaces against WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance criteria
Test user flows strictly using keyboard tab order and screen reader announcements
feynman_prompts: Why is accessibility essential for temporary situational impairments as well as disabilities?
key_misconceptions: Believing accessibility is only relevant for blind users using screen readers

nodes.title: UX Writing & Content Strategy
nodes.subtitle: Microcopy, empty states, error messages, tone of voice, terminology consistency
learning_objectives: Write clear, actionable error messages that explain what happened and how to fix it
Design empty states that encourage user action and onboarding exploration
feynman_prompts: Explain the three elements of an effective error message.
key_misconceptions: Writing generic error messages like 'Something went wrong. Try again later.'

nodes.title: Heuristic Evaluation & Expert Reviews
nodes.subtitle: Nielsen Norman 10 Usability Heuristics, severity ratings, heuristic audit reports
learning_objectives: Perform comprehensive heuristic evaluations using Nielsen's 10 usability principles
Assign severity ratings (cosmetic, minor, major, catastrophic) to identified issues
feynman_prompts: How does heuristic evaluation differ from empirical usability testing with users?
key_misconceptions: Confusing personal visual design preferences with objective heuristic violations

nodes.title: Mixed Methods UX Research
nodes.subtitle: Triangulation, survey design, Likert scales, combining telemetry data with interviews
learning_objectives: Triangulate analytics funnels with qualitative interview insights
Design robust surveys avoiding double-barreled and acquiescence bias
feynman_prompts: Why is method triangulation crucial when product stakeholders dispute research findings?
key_misconceptions: Relying exclusively on survey self-reports without behavioral verification

nodes.title: A/B Testing & UX Experimentation
nodes.subtitle: Hypothesis formation, control vs treatment, statistical significance, minimum detectable effect
learning_objectives: Formulate testable UX hypotheses linked to behavioral metrics
Interpret p-values, sample sizes, and statistical confidence in split tests
feynman_prompts: Why can optimizing solely for local click conversion damage long-term user retention?
key_misconceptions: Calling an A/B test winner prematurely before achieving statistical sample size

nodes.title: Service Design & Omnichannel UX
nodes.subtitle: Cross-device continuity, offline-to-online transitions, support integration, customer lifecycle
learning_objectives: Architect frictionless handoffs across mobile, desktop, email, and physical touchpoints
Design support escalation and post-purchase customer recovery experiences
feynman_prompts: How do you maintain user context across device switches (e.g. mobile to web)?
key_misconceptions: Designing digital screens in isolation from customer support and operational realities

nodes.title: Ethical UX & Dark Pattern Prevention
nodes.subtitle: Deceptive patterns (confirmshaming, hidden costs, roach motel), privacy by design, consent UX
learning_objectives: Identify and eliminate deceptive design patterns that exploit cognitive vulnerabilities
Design transparent cookie consent and subscription cancellation flows
feynman_prompts: Explain the business danger and regulatory penalties of employing 'roach motel' cancellation flows.
key_misconceptions: Believing dark patterns are acceptable because they drive short-term conversion boosts

nodes.title: UX for AI, Voice & Spatial Computing
nodes.subtitle: Conversational UX, VUX design, intent recognition, ambient computing, multimodal interfaces
learning_objectives: Design intuitive conversational and multimodal user interaction flows
Craft error handling and repair mechanisms for speech and LLM misunderstandings
feynman_prompts: How does conversational error handling differ from traditional GUI form validation?
key_misconceptions: Treating conversational AI as an unguided open text prompt with no affordances

nodes.title: UX Strategy & Stakeholder Management
nodes.subtitle: Executive storytelling, evangelizing UX maturity, overcoming resistance, design ROI
learning_objectives: Communicate research findings persuasively to engineering and executive leadership
Assess and elevate organizational UX maturity from reactive to strategic
feynman_prompts: How do you prioritize research insights when engineering has limited sprint capacity?
key_misconceptions: Delivering 80-page research reports that stakeholders never read instead of bite-sized insights

nodes.title: UX Portfolio & Senior Case Studies
nodes.subtitle: Reflective research documentation, impact metrics, failure analysis, portfolio defense
learning_objectives: Document end-to-end UX research and iteration cycles demonstrating business impact
Articulate research trade-offs, constraints, and pivot points during design reviews
feynman_prompts: Why does explaining what failed and how you adapted make a UX case study stronger?
key_misconceptions: Presenting UX case studies as linear, frictionless success stories with no setbacks
